pages.title: The Diet Screen
pages.text: Open your inventory and click the $(thing)Diet button$() next to the recipe book to view your nutrition status.$(br2)The Diet Screen shows:$(br2)$(li)Nutrient bars for all six food groups$(li)Trend indicators showing if bars are rising or falling$(li)Daily calorie tracking$(li)Your current balance score

pages.title: The Diet Screen
pages.text: $(li)Recently eaten foods$(li)Most neglected food groups$(li)Most fatigued food families$(br2)Check this screen regularly to spot which food groups you've been neglecting before the penalties kick in.
